# Cortex: full tool reference

> Every tool in the Cortex registry, generated by scripts/gen_agent_index.py from cortex.services.agent_orchestrator.TOOLS. 58 tools. Do not edit by hand.

Cortex is an open-source (MIT) MCP server and studio for training robot policies with an AI agent, built on LeRobot, MuJoCo, ACT (Action Chunking Transformer) and the SO-101 (SO-ARM101) arm. Your coding agent describes the robot arm and the task over the Model Context Protocol; Cortex builds a MuJoCo simulation, collects simulator-verified demonstrations, trains an ACT or SmolVLA policy and evaluates it, with a human approving every step that costs money or moves hardware.

- MCP: http://localhost:3000/mcp (streamable HTTP). Tools are named `cortex.<name>`. The MCP server splits `robot_act` into one tool per robot action (`cortex.robot_observe`, `cortex.robot_move`, ...).
- REST: `GET http://localhost:8000/api/tools` returns this list as JSON; `POST http://localhost:8000/api/tools/<name>` with the arguments as the JSON body calls a tool. Remote callers need `Authorization: Bearer <CORTEX_MCP_KEY>`.
- Every result has `summary` and `ref_ids`, plus tool-specific data. Long jobs return a `job_id`; poll `get_job`.
- `agent_callable: false` means the studio's built-in agent does not get the tool; MCP clients can still call it.
- `needs approval` means a person must approve in the studio before work starts.

## Tools

### create_project

MCP: `cortex.create_project` · REST: `POST /api/tools/create_project`

Create a project for the built-in cube task only (for any other object use start_intake); returns task spec, success criteria and an initial demonstration plan.

Arguments:

- `task_prompt` (string, required): What the robot should learn, in plain language
- `mode` ("sim" | "real", default "sim"): 'sim' (default) or 'real'
- `demo_budget` (integer, default 24)

JSON schema:

```json
{"$defs":{"Mode":{"enum":["sim","real"],"type":"string"}},"properties":{"task_prompt":{"description":"What the robot should learn, in plain language","type":"string"},"mode":{"$ref":"#/$defs/Mode","default":"sim","description":"'sim' (default) or 'real'"},"demo_budget":{"default":24,"type":"integer"}},"required":["task_prompt"],"type":"object"}
```

### get_project_state

MCP: `cortex.get_project_state` · REST: `POST /api/tools/get_project_state`

Counts, datasets, training jobs, evaluations, open recommendations and next actions.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### list_episodes

MCP: `cortex.list_episodes` · REST: `POST /api/tools/list_episodes`

List recorded demonstrations with condition, seed, success and quality flags.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `status` ("recorded" | "accepted" | "rejected" | null, default null)

JSON schema:

```json
{"$defs":{"EpisodeStatus":{"enum":["recorded","accepted","rejected"],"type":"string"}},"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"status":{"anyOf":[{"$ref":"#/$defs/EpisodeStatus"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### record_demonstrations

MCP: `cortex.record_demonstrations` · REST: `POST /api/tools/record_demonstrations`

Record scripted-expert demonstrations in MuJoCo for the given conditions (simulation only; cube_region applies to the built-in cube task only).

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `conditions` (list[ConditionCount], required)
- `auto_accept` (boolean, default true): accept demos that succeed and pass quality checks
- `recommendation_id` (string | null, default null)
- `wait_s` (integer, default 0, >= 0, <= 600): block up to this many seconds for completion

ConditionCount:

  - `cube_region` ("left" | "center" | "right", default "center")
  - `lighting` ("dim" | "normal" | "bright", default "normal")
  - `count` (integer, default 1, >= 1, <= 20)

JSON schema:

```json
{"$defs":{"ConditionCount":{"properties":{"cube_region":{"default":"center","enum":["left","center","right"],"type":"string"},"lighting":{"default":"normal","enum":["dim","normal","bright"],"type":"string"},"count":{"default":1,"maximum":20,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}},"type":"object"}},"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"conditions":{"items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/ConditionCount"},"type":"array"},"auto_accept":{"default":true,"description":"accept demos that succeed and pass quality checks","type":"boolean"},"recommendation_id":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null},"wait_s":{"default":0,"description":"block up to this many seconds for completion","maximum":600,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}},"required":["project_id","conditions"],"type":"object"}
```

### analyze_dataset

MCP: `cortex.analyze_dataset` · REST: `POST /api/tools/analyze_dataset`

Run quality checks, telemetry failure analysis and VLM hypotheses; builds failure clusters.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `use_vlm` (boolean, default true)
- `wait_s` (integer, default 0, >= 0, <= 600)

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"use_vlm":{"default":true,"type":"boolean"},"wait_s":{"default":0,"maximum":600,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### check_dataset_readiness

MCP: `cortex.check_dataset_readiness` · REST: `POST /api/tools/check_dataset_readiness`

Before training: check demos for problems that don't show in the loss (idle starts/ends, an unused gripper, glitch steps, actions out of sync with state, mixed frame rates, shapes or units, thin conditions). Returns ready / ready_with_warnings / blocked with the episodes involved. Reports only; changes nothing.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `dataset_version_id` (string | null, default null): check a dataset version's episodes (ds_...)
- `episode_ids` (list[string] | null, default null): check these episodes; default: every accepted one

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"dataset_version_id":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"check a dataset version's episodes (ds_...)"},"episode_ids":{"anyOf":[{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"check these episodes; default: every accepted one"}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### create_dataset_version

MCP: `cortex.create_dataset_version` · REST: `POST /api/tools/create_dataset_version`

Snapshot accepted episodes as a versioned LeRobotDataset v3 with lineage, train/eval split and optional image-only augmentation.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `augmentation_preset` ("lighting_robustness" | null, default null): brightness x2, color temperature and shadow views of each train episode
- `augmentations` (list[Augmentation], default [])
- `eval_fraction` (number, default 0.2)
- `name` (string | null, default null)
- `wait_s` (integer, default 0, >= 0, <= 600)

Augmentation:

  - `type` ("brightness" | "contrast" | "color_temperature" | "shadow" | "hue_saturation" | "blur" | "noise" | "camera_jitter", required)
  - `params` (dict[string, number], required)

JSON schema:

```json
{"$defs":{"Augmentation":{"properties":{"type":{"enum":["brightness","contrast","color_temperature","shadow","hue_saturation","blur","noise","camera_jitter"],"type":"string"},"params":{"additionalProperties":{"type":"number"},"type":"object"}},"required":["type","params"],"type":"object"}},"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"augmentation_preset":{"anyOf":[{"const":"lighting_robustness","type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"brightness x2, color temperature and shadow views of each train episode"},"augmentations":{"default":[],"items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/Augmentation"},"type":"array"},"eval_fraction":{"default":0.2,"type":"number"},"name":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null},"wait_s":{"default":0,"maximum":600,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### propose_training_job

MCP: `cortex.propose_training_job` · REST: `POST /api/tools/propose_training_job` · needs approval

Propose an ACT/SmolVLA training job with config and resource estimate (does not start it). Pass base_checkpoint_id to continue fine-tuning an existing policy (e.g. for this robot or new data) instead of starting from scratch.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `dataset_version_id` (string, required)
- `policy_type` ("act" | "smolvla", default "act")
- `steps` (integer | null, default null)
- `base_checkpoint_id` (string | null, default null): continue fine-tuning this checkpoint (any project) instead of training from scratch

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"dataset_version_id":{"type":"string"},"policy_type":{"default":"act","enum":["act","smolvla"],"type":"string"},"steps":{"anyOf":[{"type":"integer"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null},"base_checkpoint_id":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"continue fine-tuning this checkpoint (any project) instead of training from scratch"}},"required":["project_id","dataset_version_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### launch_training_job

MCP: `cortex.launch_training_job` · REST: `POST /api/tools/launch_training_job` · agent_callable: false · needs approval

Launch an approved training job. Refused unless a human approved it in the studio or a valid operator approval_token is given.

Arguments:

- `training_job_id` (string, required)
- `approval_token` (string | null, default null): operator token; otherwise approve in the studio

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"training_job_id":{"type":"string"},"approval_token":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"operator token; otherwise approve in the studio"}},"required":["training_job_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### register_training_checkpoint

MCP: `cortex.register_training_checkpoint` · REST: `POST /api/tools/register_training_checkpoint`

Finish a launched manual training job: register its trained LeRobot checkpoint (the pretrained_model directory launch_training_job named, inside the data dir). Marks that job succeeded.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `training_job_id` (string, required): the launched manual training job (tj_...) this checkpoint came from
- `path` (string, required): the job's pretrained_model directory (config.json + model.safetensors) inside the Cortex data dir; launch_training_job returns the exact path
- `step` (integer | null, default null)

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"training_job_id":{"description":"the launched manual training job (tj_...) this checkpoint came from","type":"string"},"path":{"description":"the job's pretrained_model directory (config.json + model.safetensors) inside the Cortex data dir; launch_training_job returns the exact path","type":"string"},"step":{"anyOf":[{"type":"integer"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null}},"required":["project_id","training_job_id","path"],"type":"object"}
```

### launch_simulation_evaluation

MCP: `cortex.launch_simulation_evaluation` · REST: `POST /api/tools/launch_simulation_evaluation` · needs approval

Evaluate a policy in parallel MuJoCo branches: baseline, shifted object, dim lighting. Records seeds, successes, rewards and videos.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `policy` (string, default "scripted_expert"): 'scripted_expert' or a checkpoint id (ck_...)
- `episodes_per_branch` (integer, default 10, >= 1, <= 50)
- `base_seed` (integer, default 1000)
- `wait_s` (integer, default 0, >= 0, <= 900)

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"policy":{"default":"scripted_expert","description":"'scripted_expert' or a checkpoint id (ck_...)","type":"string"},"episodes_per_branch":{"default":10,"maximum":50,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"base_seed":{"default":1000,"type":"integer"},"wait_s":{"default":0,"maximum":900,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### create_policy_project

MCP: `cortex.create_policy_project` · REST: `POST /api/tools/create_policy_project`

Create a project for a manipulation policy and (by default) start autonomous agent demonstration collection (our self-hosted VLM, or GPT-6 Astra) within the planner budget.

Arguments:

- `task_prompt` (string, required): e.g. 'Train an SO-101 policy to pick up a cube and place it in a bowl'
- `num_demos` (integer, default 20, >= 1, <= 50): autonomous demonstration attempts to run
- `start_collection` (boolean, default true)
- `diversity` ("plan" | "medium" | "high", default "medium")
- `model_budget_usd` (number | null, default null): planner spend cap; can only lower the server default, never raise it

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"task_prompt":{"description":"e.g. 'Train an SO-101 policy to pick up a cube and place it in a bowl'","type":"string"},"num_demos":{"default":20,"description":"autonomous demonstration attempts to run","maximum":50,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"start_collection":{"default":true,"type":"boolean"},"diversity":{"default":"medium","enum":["plan","medium","high"],"type":"string"},"model_budget_usd":{"anyOf":[{"exclusiveMinimum":0,"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"planner spend cap; can only lower the server default, never raise it"}},"required":["task_prompt"],"type":"object"}
```

### start_agent_collection

MCP: `cortex.start_agent_collection` · REST: `POST /api/tools/start_agent_collection`

Generate demonstrations autonomously: the agent planner (self-hosted VLM or GPT-6 Astra) plans from camera images, validated IK executes in MuJoCo, simulator-verified successes become LeRobot episodes. Returns job_id.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `num_demos` (integer, default 6, >= 1, <= 50)
- `diversity` ("plan" | "medium" | "high", default "medium")
- `conditions` (list[Cell] | null, default null): target these cells only (e.g. a weak condition)
- `collector` ("agent" | "oracle", default "agent")
- `max_total_usd` (number | null, default null)
- `mode` ("camera" | "privileged" | null, default null)

Cell:

  - `cube_region` ("left" | "center" | "right", required)
  - `lighting` ("dim" | "normal" | "bright", default "normal")

JSON schema:

```json
{"$defs":{"Cell":{"properties":{"cube_region":{"enum":["left","center","right"],"type":"string"},"lighting":{"default":"normal","enum":["dim","normal","bright"],"type":"string"}},"required":["cube_region"],"type":"object"}},"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"num_demos":{"default":6,"maximum":50,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"diversity":{"default":"medium","enum":["plan","medium","high"],"type":"string"},"conditions":{"anyOf":[{"items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/Cell"},"type":"array"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"target these cells only (e.g. a weak condition)"},"collector":{"default":"agent","enum":["agent","oracle"],"type":"string"},"max_total_usd":{"anyOf":[{"exclusiveMinimum":0,"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null},"mode":{"anyOf":[{"enum":["camera","privileged"],"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### train_from_agent_demonstrations

MCP: `cortex.train_from_agent_demonstrations` · REST: `POST /api/tools/train_from_agent_demonstrations`

Build a dataset version from agent-generated demos and propose ACT training (training itself needs approval). Returns job_id.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `sources` (list["sim_agent" | "sim_scripted"], default ["sim_agent"])
- `augmentation_preset` ("lighting_robustness" | null, default null)
- `policy_type` ("act" | "smolvla", default "act")

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"sources":{"default":["sim_agent"],"items":{"enum":["sim_agent","sim_scripted"],"type":"string"},"type":"array"},"augmentation_preset":{"anyOf":[{"const":"lighting_robustness","type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null},"policy_type":{"default":"act","enum":["act","smolvla"],"type":"string"}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### evaluate_learned_policy

MCP: `cortex.evaluate_learned_policy` · REST: `POST /api/tools/evaluate_learned_policy`

Evaluate a trained checkpoint (never the oracle) in the three parallel MuJoCo conditions.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `checkpoint_id` (string, required, matches `^ck_`): a trained checkpoint (not the scripted oracle)
- `episodes_per_branch` (integer, default 10, >= 1, <= 50)

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"checkpoint_id":{"description":"a trained checkpoint (not the scripted oracle)","pattern":"^ck_","type":"string"},"episodes_per_branch":{"default":10,"maximum":50,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}},"required":["project_id","checkpoint_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### import_demonstrations

MCP: `cortex.import_demonstrations` · REST: `POST /api/tools/import_demonstrations`

Import existing human/robot demonstrations from a LeRobot dataset on the Hugging Face Hub (the user's own SO-101 recordings or public ones). Returns job_id.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `repo_id` (string, required): Hugging Face dataset repo id, e.g. 'lerobot/svla_so101_pickplace' or the user's own 'user/my_so101_demos'
- `max_episodes` (integer, default 10, >= 1, <= 50)

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"repo_id":{"description":"Hugging Face dataset repo id, e.g. 'lerobot/svla_so101_pickplace' or the user's own 'user/my_so101_demos'","type":"string"},"max_episodes":{"default":10,"maximum":50,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}},"required":["project_id","repo_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### set_infrastructure

MCP: `cortex.set_infrastructure` · REST: `POST /api/tools/set_infrastructure`

Change this project's infrastructure choices (planner, training backend, GPU, walltime). Only stores the choice: training still needs the human's approval.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `planner` ("auto" | "claude_code" | "model" | null, default null)
- `training_backend` ("auto" | "futurama_slurm" | "manual" | null, default null)
- `training_gres` ("gpu:l40s:1" | "gpu:l40:1" | "gpu:l4:1" | "gpu:h200:1" | null, default null)
- `training_walltime_min` (integer | null, default null)

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"planner":{"anyOf":[{"enum":["auto","claude_code","model"],"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null},"training_backend":{"anyOf":[{"enum":["auto","futurama_slurm","manual"],"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null},"training_gres":{"anyOf":[{"enum":["gpu:l40s:1","gpu:l40:1","gpu:l4:1","gpu:h200:1"],"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null},"training_walltime_min":{"anyOf":[{"maximum":1440,"minimum":15,"type":"integer"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### robot_start_episode


### robot_act

MCP: `cortex.robot_observe`, `cortex.robot_state`, `cortex.robot_propose_grasp`, `cortex.robot_move`, `cortex.robot_gripper`, `cortex.robot_verify_grasp`, `cortex.robot_place`, `cortex.robot_check_success` · REST: `POST /api/tools/robot_act` · agent_callable: false

Simulated arm (MuJoCo, no hardware): run one validated robot tool in your session (observe_scene, get_robot_state, propose_grasp, move_end_effector, set_gripper, verify_grasp, place_object, check_task_success).

Arguments:

- `session_id` (string, required)
- `tool` ("observe_scene" | "get_robot_state" | "propose_grasp" | "move_end_effector" | "set_gripper" | "verify_grasp" | "place_object" | "check_task_success", required)
- `args` (object, default {})

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string"},"tool":{"enum":["observe_scene","get_robot_state","propose_grasp","move_end_effector","set_gripper","verify_grasp","place_object","check_task_success"],"type":"string"},"args":{"additionalProperties":true,"default":{},"type":"object"}},"required":["session_id","tool"],"type":"object"}
```

### robot_finish_episode

MCP: `cortex.robot_finish_episode` · REST: `POST /api/tools/robot_finish_episode` · agent_callable: false

Simulated arm (MuJoCo, no hardware): end your episode; the simulator judges success and successes become demonstrations.

Arguments:

- `believes_success` (boolean, required)
- `summary` (string, default "", max length 400)

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string"},"believes_success":{"type":"boolean"},"summary":{"default":"","maxLength":400,"type":"string"}},"required":["session_id","believes_success"],"type":"object"}
```

### improve_policy

MCP: `cortex.improve_policy` · REST: `POST /api/tools/improve_policy`

Find the weakest measured condition, collect targeted agent demos there in fresh seeds, build a new dataset version and propose retraining. Returns job_id.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `max_new_demos` (integer, default 5, >= 1, <= 20)
- `max_usd` (number | null, default null)

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"max_new_demos":{"default":5,"maximum":20,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"max_usd":{"anyOf":[{"exclusiveMinimum":0,"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### start_intake

MCP: `cortex.start_intake` · REST: `POST /api/tools/start_intake`

Start describing a robot-learning task: creates a draft project (with project_id: starts that project's intake over) and returns typed questions (each with a ready-to-send patch) about the arm, cameras, objects, place zones, environment and task.

Arguments:

- `prompt` (string, default ""): The task in plain language, e.g. 'pick up the water bottle and put it on the coaster'. Objects named here are pre-filled from a catalogue.
- `mode` ("sim" | "real", default "sim"): 'sim' (the MVP runs everything in physics sim) or 'real'
- `project_id` (string | null, default null): Start this existing project's intake over from the prompt instead of creating a new project

JSON schema:

```json
{"$defs":{"Mode":{"enum":["sim","real"],"type":"string"}},"properties":{"prompt":{"default":"","description":"The task in plain language, e.g. 'pick up the water bottle and put it on the coaster'. Objects named here are pre-filled from a catalogue.","type":"string"},"mode":{"$ref":"#/$defs/Mode","default":"sim","description":"'sim' (the MVP runs everything in physics sim) or 'real'"},"project_id":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"Start this existing project's intake over from the prompt instead of creating a new project"}},"type":"object"}
```

### get_policy_weaknesses

MCP: `cortex.get_policy_weaknesses` · REST: `POST /api/tools/get_policy_weaknesses`

Where the trained policy is weak, measured from its latest sim evaluation: per condition the success rate with a Wilson 95% interval and n, failure modes from sim telemetry, start-state clusters, and VLM hypotheses (unverified). Ranked by the gap that holds at the upper bound.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `checkpoint_id` (string | null, default null): a trained checkpoint; default: the latest evaluated one
- `target` (number, default 0.8, >= 0, <= 1): success rate a condition should reach

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"checkpoint_id":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"a trained checkpoint; default: the latest evaluated one"},"target":{"default":0.8,"description":"success rate a condition should reach","maximum":1,"minimum":0,"type":"number"}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### propose_rl_sandboxes

MCP: `cortex.propose_rl_sandboxes` · REST: `POST /api/tools/propose_rl_sandboxes`

Propose one RL sandbox per top weakness (skill-parameter RL with CEM, which tunes the validated IK skill; its successful rollouts become targeted demos for retraining ACT). Each runs a measured pilot as a job, then reports the pilot, predicted sandbox success, predicted policy uplift, P(uplift >= delta), regression elsewhere, cost (episodes, CPU hours, $) and assumptions. Predictions are labelled estimates with their source (measured, prior or learned).

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `checkpoint_id` (string | null, default null)
- `max_sandboxes` (integer, default 3, >= 1, <= 6)
- `budget` (object | null, default null): SandboxBudget overrides: iterations (<=15), population, pilot_episodes, demos, heldout_episodes, max_parallel
- `wait_s` (integer, default 0, >= 0, <= 300): wait up to this long for the pilots to finish

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"checkpoint_id":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null},"max_sandboxes":{"default":3,"maximum":6,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"budget":{"anyOf":[{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"SandboxBudget overrides: iterations (<=15), population, pilot_episodes, demos, heldout_episodes, max_parallel"},"wait_s":{"default":0,"description":"wait up to this long for the pilots to finish","maximum":300,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### accept_rl_sandboxes

MCP: `cortex.accept_rl_sandboxes` · REST: `POST /api/tools/accept_rl_sandboxes`

Start sandboxes whose pilot has finished. Local CPU sandboxes cost $0 and you may accept them within budget_cap and the project's standing budget. GPU or paid sandboxes return approval_required: a human approves them in the studio.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `ids` (list[string], required): sandbox ids from propose_rl_sandboxes (status 'ready')
- `budget_cap` (number, default 0.0, >= 0): the most you allow these sandboxes to cost, in USD. Local CPU sandboxes cost $0
- `max_cpu_hours` (number | null, default null): optional cap on estimated CPU hours

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"ids":{"description":"sandbox ids from propose_rl_sandboxes (status 'ready')","items":{"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"},"budget_cap":{"default":0.0,"description":"the most you allow these sandboxes to cost, in USD. Local CPU sandboxes cost $0","minimum":0,"type":"number"},"max_cpu_hours":{"anyOf":[{"exclusiveMinimum":0,"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"optional cap on estimated CPU hours"}},"required":["project_id","ids"],"type":"object"}
```

### close_rl_round

MCP: `cortex.close_rl_round` · REST: `POST /api/tools/close_rl_round`

Close the loop for a finished RL sandbox, one step per call (call again to continue): its successful demos (provenance rl_sandbox:<id>, quality-gated) go into a new version of the latest dataset, capped so targeted demos stay at most 40% of the train split; then a retrain is PROPOSED (a human approves it); once its checkpoint exists, the old and new checkpoints are re-evaluated on every condition on matched held-out seeds (McNemar per condition, regressions flagged), the predicted vs realised uplift is logged and the transfer curve refitted (learned after 3 realised rounds, prior before).

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `sandbox_id` (string, required): a finished sandbox (rl_...) with a measured held-out result
- `episodes_per_condition` (integer | null, default null): matched held-out seeds per condition in the re-evaluation; default: the n of the evaluation the weakness came from
- `wait_s` (integer, default 0, >= 0, <= 300): keep advancing for up to this long while a dataset build or the re-evaluation runs

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"sandbox_id":{"description":"a finished sandbox (rl_...) with a measured held-out result","type":"string"},"episodes_per_condition":{"anyOf":[{"maximum":200,"minimum":5,"type":"integer"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"matched held-out seeds per condition in the re-evaluation; default: the n of the evaluation the weakness came from"},"wait_s":{"default":0,"description":"keep advancing for up to this long while a dataset build or the re-evaluation runs","maximum":300,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}},"required":["project_id","sandbox_id"],"type":"object"}
```

### submit_failure_hypotheses

MCP: REST only · REST: `POST /api/tools/submit_failure_hypotheses` · agent_callable: false

Store your model's failure hypotheses for an analysis from get_diagnosis_inputs. Validated against the fixed taxonomy (any invalid answer rejects the submission); stored as unverified VLM hypotheses with the route and the model you report, then failure clusters are rebuilt.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string, required)
- `analysis_id` (string, required): analysis_id from get_diagnosis_inputs
- `route` ("mcp_sampling" | "mcp_agent", required): 'mcp_sampling' when the answers came from a sampling/createMessage request, 'mcp_agent' when you (the agent) looked at the contact sheets yourself
- `model` (string, required, max length 120): the model that produced the answers, as reported by the MCP client (sampling result `model`)
- `client` (string | null, default null): MCP client name/version, if known
- `answers` (list[TargetAnswer], required)

SubmittedHypothesis:

  - `category` (string, required): one of the fixed failure taxonomy categories
  - `confidence` (number, required, >= 0, <= 1): the model's own confidence, 0-1 (not a probability)
  - `rationale` (string, required, max length 300)
  - `frame_indices` (list[integer], optional): keyframes (0-5) that show it

TargetAnswer:

  - `ref_id` (string, required): target ref_id from get_diagnosis_inputs
  - `reply_text` (string | null, default null): the model's raw reply; parsed and validated by Cortex
  - `hypotheses` (list[SubmittedHypothesis] | null, default null): structured hypotheses (instead of reply_text)
  - `error` (string | null, default null): the client could not get an answer (declined, failed); recorded, never replaced by a guess

JSON schema:

```json
{"$defs":{"SubmittedHypothesis":{"properties":{"category":{"description":"one of the fixed failure taxonomy categories","type":"string"},"confidence":{"description":"the model's own confidence, 0-1 (not a probability)","maximum":1,"minimum":0,"type":"number"},"rationale":{"maxLength":300,"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"frame_indices":{"description":"keyframes (0-5) that show it","items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":6,"type":"array"}},"required":["category","confidence","rationale"],"type":"object"},"TargetAnswer":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"ref_id":{"description":"target ref_id from get_diagnosis_inputs","type":"string"},"reply_text":{"anyOf":[{"maxLength":8000,"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"the model's raw reply; parsed and validated by Cortex"},"hypotheses":{"anyOf":[{"items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/SubmittedHypothesis"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":1,"type":"array"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"structured hypotheses (instead of reply_text)"},"error":{"anyOf":[{"maxLength":300,"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"the client could not get an answer (declined, failed); recorded, never replaced by a guess"}},"required":["ref_id"],"type":"object"}},"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"project_id":{"type":"string"},"analysis_id":{"description":"analysis_id from get_diagnosis_inputs","type":"string"},"route":{"description":"'mcp_sampling' when the answers came from a sampling/createMessage request, 'mcp_agent' when you (the agent) looked at the contact sheets yourself","enum":["mcp_sampling","mcp_agent"],"type":"string"},"model":{"description":"the model that produced the answers, as reported by the MCP client (sampling result `model`)","maxLength":120,"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"client":{"anyOf":[{"maxLength":120,"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"MCP client name/version, if known"},"answers":{"items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/TargetAnswer"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":1,"type":"array"}},"required":["project_id","analysis_id","route","model","answers"],"type":"object"}
```

### list

Use it to find ids, check what exists before creating something, and see what you (or another agent) already did.

### request_gpu

MCP: `cortex.request_gpu` · REST: `POST /api/tools/request_gpu`

Request a GPU on Georgia Tech's Futurama cluster through Slurm (the studio's Request a GPU button), or attach to one already running. It loads the newest trained policies so they can run live. Free for the user, but cluster access is limited: one server at a time, and after a failed request Cortex waits 10 min before asking again. Returns at once; poll cortex_get_gpu_status until available. Needs the GT VPN and FUTURAMA_SSH_HOST on the backend.

Arguments:

- `project_id` (string | null, default null): the project this GPU is for, so the request shows in its Agent log

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"project_id":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"the project this GPU is for, so the request shows in its Agent log"}},"type":"object"}
```

### deploy_physical_skill

MCP: `cortex.deploy_physical_skill` · REST: `POST /api/tools/deploy_physical_skill`

Deploy a Physical Skill: requests or attaches the Futurama GPU server (the same safeguards as request_gpu) and sets up a live closed-loop run of the skill in the deployment simulator, on an unseen layout. Returns deployment_url (the studio page that plays the run; share it as View deployment) and the run id. While the GPU comes up it returns deployed=false: poll get_gpu_status, then call it again. Find skills with cortex_list(kind="skills").

Arguments:

- `skill_id` (string, required): a Physical Skill id (sk_...), from save_physical_skill or cortex_list(kind="skills")

JSON schema:

```json
{"properties":{"skill_id":{"description":"a Physical Skill id (sk_...), from save_physical_skill or cortex_list(kind=\"skills\")","type":"string"}},"required":["skill_id"],"type":"object"}
```
